Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Integration of health records, patient registration, immunization data, and health insurance into data exchange
Comments: Public Digital supported establishment of a foundation for digital health transformation and a digital health roadmap for Madagascar. No confirmed operational integration of health systems into the X-Road/Rahaka platform as yet.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Original cited source (Public Digital case study) does not actually discuss health integration — it covers digital ID and business registration only, so it did not support this score. Fresher, authoritative reporting corrects this: at the official national interoperability (Rahaka/X-Road) launch on 28 April 2026, the Minister of Digital Development confirmed the exchange was already operational for EDBM, CNAPS, INSTAT, the Ministry of Justice and the tax authority (DGI) — health was cited only as a future/conditional example ('cette interopérabilité permettrait d'accéder...'), not as a live integration (L'Express Madagascar/AllAfrica, 28-29 Apr 2026). Separate health-digitisation efforts (hospital digitisation pilot at CHU HJRA/CHU SSPA from March 2025, National Digital Health Strategy 2023-2027, and a DHIS2/One Health laboratory platform from May 2025) show active groundwork but no confirmed link to the Rahaka exchange. This confirms Value Code 2 (Planned) on the exchange_func_health scale; code is unchanged but now rests on verified, dated evidence rather than an off-topic source.
